summary: Session/telemetry update for the current vehicle slot. Reads two flag properties (flag 2048) to obtain a vehicle slot index v6 and a session-state value v7, addresses the vehicle as (0x5EC6D8 base + 18624 * v6), and dispatches AI commands (5 for the active state, 4 for the transition/pit state) with a vehicle substate update; when the slot is the player vehicle it additionally runs pfnAPC and StateResetOnCondition. Rate-limits a progress-bar telemetry event to every 3 seconds, advancing a 432-byte ring buffer for encoded events, and clears the object's buffer entry each call.

local_names.v7: session-state value returned by FlagPropertyGetter(flag 2048), compared against -11
local_names.v3: ring-buffer event slot pointer (dword_8AAE64, advanced by 432 per event)

Branches on the session-state value v7 not equal to -11
Active-state path: AICommandMessageQueueDispatcher(v2, 5, 0) queues AI command 5 for the vehicle slot
sub_4A5F20 updates the vehicle telemetry substate at v2 + 13004
When the addressed slot is the player vehicle (v2 == dword_7C54E8): pfnAPC(0) and StateResetOnCondition(&dword_5EA510)

sub_4A5EA0 updates the vehicle telemetry substate at v2 + 13004
